Pehla Point: PRD khud kya bol raha hai?

Sticky types 6 hain:

Sticky TypeExampleWebSocket
ReminderMedicine RefillOptional
ActionMembership RenewOptional
InformationLab Report ReadyOptional
PromotionDiscount BannerOptional
Live/StatefulFood Order TrackingRecommended
Live/StatefulVideo CallRecommended

PRD khud bolta hai ki WebSocket optional hai aur Phase-1 mein REST hi banana hai. Hamari current infra sirf 2 servers, 8 workers aur heavy DB fan-out par chal rahi hai. Isliye Membership, Refill, Reports, Invoices jaise stickies ke liye REST/Polling practical hai. WebSocket sirf genuinely live use-cases (order tracking, video call) ke liye future phase mein add karna chahiye jab Redis Pub/Sub aur event infrastructure ready ho.

PRD ko strictly follow karein toh end-state architecture WebSocket-based hai for Live/Stateful stickies (Food Order, Video Call). But PRD equally clearly says Phase 1 is REST + Mongo foundation, and most sticky types (Membership, Refill, Reports, Invoices, Promotions, Reminders) do not require WebSocket at all.
